port_test.configuration: N=3, as hpdcache instantiates it; the hpdcache memory write request layout with a 64-bit address, 8-bit burst length and 4-bit ID, and the write-data layout with 64-bit data, 8-bit byte enable and last; eight requests per source; burst lengths one, two, three, recorded in the request length field; 600 cycles with independent request and data backpressure.
port_test.comparison_scope: Ready-valid handshake and burst-last marker. The first request or data output transfer selects an accepted transaction; the other output channel must agree on the same transaction order. Requests and beats within each source retain their order. No total order across sources is imposed from their acceptance times. Arbitration during simultaneous valid requests is observed without enforcing a fixed priority choice. Only transfers and stalled valid payloads are compared; buffer capacity and feed-through mode are not fixed.
port_test.environment: Linux, Python 3, Git, Verilator --binary --timing, C++ and make. CVA6_REPO must contain the recorded HPDcache submodule Git objects.
